dialogues.speaker: Changchang
dialogues.text: I've got a new wish this Lantern Rite — just once, I wanna see the fireworks with Daddy!

dialogues.speaker: Changchang
dialogues.text: If he can't make it this year, then next time, then next-next time, and next-next-next time... One day, my wish will come true!

dialogues.speaker: Changchang
dialogues.text: Ah, how am I going to feed it...

dialogues.speaker: Changchang
dialogues.text: I'm wondering how to feed the puppy that I met earlier.

dialogues.speaker: Changchang
dialogues.text: Granddad said before that the city was in too much of a mess, and he wouldn't let me go feed it.

dialogues.speaker: Changchang
dialogues.text: Although he says that everything's fine in the city now, he's been too busy to take me there...

dialogues.speaker: Changchang
dialogues.text: We haven't fed that puppy for so long... I hope it hasn't starved yet. Granddad says that puppies can find food for themselves, but I'm worried.

dialogues.speaker: Changchang
dialogues.text: Could you help me go to the city gate and feed my puppy?

response.speaker: Changchang
response.text: Granddad usually prepares the doggy food, but it's Fowl... I think.

response.speaker: Changchang
response.text: Um, then... Could you help me get a portion of Fowl to feed our puppy with?

response.speaker: Changchang
response.text: Please hurry — I... I don't want it to starve...

choices.text: I've got a fear of dogs...

response.speaker: Changchang
response.text: Oh, don't be scared! It's a good puppy, it won't bite you.

dialogues.speaker: Changchang
dialogues.text: When is Daddy coming back... Oh, hello, nice to meet you!

dialogues.speaker: Changchang
dialogues.text: Hee-hee, everyone says I'm very polite for my age. Are you waiting for someone too?

choices.text: Are you here on your own?

response.speaker: Changchang
response.text: Yep! But it's okay, I'm very grown-up for my age and I play by myself all the time! Granddad works in the Dockyard as a conduction worker... conduction...? Construction, construction worker. I made a boo-boo again.

response.speaker: Changchang
response.text: I'm not scared though, everyone's really nice here and there's the Millelith to beat up all the bad guys!

response.speaker: Changchang
response.text: Right now I'm not playing. I'm doing something very important!

response.speaker: Changchang
response.text: I'm waiting for Daddy. I've lost count of how many days he's been away now...

response.speaker: Changchang
response.text: But whenever Daddy comes home he always brings lots and lots of pressies!

response.speaker: Changchang
response.text: Last time, he brought me some new clothes! And the time before that, he brought me a windmill! And the time before that, he brought me loads and loads and loads of candy!

response.speaker: Changchang
response.text: ...And the time before that, he brought me, erm, a porcelain doll! And, and, and... Wolfhook Cake! And a little bottle that lights up in the wind! And a purple hourglass! And...

dialogues.speaker: Changchang
dialogues.text: I'm Changchang, I just donated Dolly. She's my ragdoll.

dialogues.speaker: Changchang
dialogues.text: Last night in my dream, Dolly told me her wish was to fly up into the sky and see the view.

dialogues.speaker: Changchang
dialogues.text: So I gave her to the lady over by the big deer lantern. Dolly's wish will come true now, won't it?

dialogues.speaker: Changchang
dialogues.text: I did the right thing, didn't I? Wishes are supposed to come true at Lantern Rite, aren't they?
